name: Helmed Horror
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

trait.name: Elite (Modo Fatal · 5 PJs nível 14)
entries: Versão nivelada para cima: PV ×1,6, CA +2, ataques, salvaguardas e CDs +3, dados de dano ×1,5 e +3 de dano fixo. ND efetivo +3.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The helmed horror has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spell Immunity
entries: The helmed horror is immune to three spells chosen by its creator. Typical choices include {@spell Heat Metal|XPHB}, {@spell Lightning Bolt|XPHB}, and {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The helmed horror makes two Arcane Sword attacks.

action.name: Arcane Sword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) Slashing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Force damage.

fluffEntries: Armaduras da Casa: sentinelas de Osybus em formação.
